items.question: How quickly do you respond to enquiries?
items.answer: Our team usually responds within 2–3 business hours during Saudi office hours. WhatsApp inquiries receive the fastest response.

items.question: How long does it take to deploy workers?
items.answer: Deployment generally takes 15–30 days depending on visa approval, documentation, and the required profession.

items.question: What information should I include in my enquiry?
items.answer: Please mention the job category, number of workers required, project location, expected joining date, and your contact information.

items.question: Can I visit your Riyadh office?
items.answer: Yes. We welcome employers to visit our Riyadh office by appointment during business hours.

items.question: Is there a minimum order for manpower supply?
items.answer: No. We can provide a single worker or hundreds of workers depending on your business requirements.

items.question: Which industries do you supply workers for?
items.answer: We provide manpower for construction, hospitality, cleaning, logistics, security, healthcare, factories, supermarkets, offices, restaurants and many more.

item1.question: What is Future Focus Company?
item1.answer: Future Focus Company is a premium, government-approved manpower recruitment agency specializing in sourcing, screening, and deploying skilled and semi-skilled workforce from 10+ countries to Saudi Arabia and the GCC.

item2.question: Which industries do you supply manpower for?
item2.answer: We supply workforce for a wide range of sectors including Construction & Engineering, Healthcare, Hospitality, IT & Technology, Transport & Heavy Driving, and Facility Management.

item3.question: From which countries do you source your candidates?
item3.answer: While our primary recruitment hub is Bangladesh, we have a strong global network to source qualified talent from over 10 countries across Asia and Africa to meet diverse employer needs.

item4.question: Do you supply both skilled and unskilled workers?
item4.answer: Yes, we provide highly skilled professionals (engineers, nurses, developers), semi-skilled workers (welders, drivers, chefs), and unskilled labor for support roles.

item5.question: Are your candidates trade-tested?
item5.answer: Absolutely. All technical and skilled candidates undergo rigorous practical trade testing and evaluation at our affiliated certified testing centers before final selection.

item6.question: How long does the recruitment and deployment process take?
item6.answer: Standard deployment typically takes between 30 to 45 days after the final selection and receipt of the original visa documents, subject to medical and embassy clearance.

item7.question: How do I request a manpower proposal?
item7.answer: You can easily request a proposal by clicking the 'Request Manpower' button on our website, filling out your headcount and sector requirements. Our team will get back to you within 24 hours.

item8.question: What is your replacement guarantee?
item8.answer: We offer a 100% compliant 90-day free replacement guarantee. If a deployed worker is found medically or technically unfit within the probation period, we will replace them at no extra agency service cost.

item9.question: Can our HR team interview the candidates directly?
item9.answer: Yes, we highly encourage this. We facilitate online video interviews (via Zoom/Teams) and can also arrange logistics if your HR delegates wish to visit our recruitment centers for in-person evaluations.

item10.question: Do you handle visa processing and medical clearances?
item10.answer: Yes, we provide end-to-end solutions. This includes GAMCA medical checkups, background verification, visa stamping, and ticketing.

item11.question: Are your services compliant with GCC labor laws?
item11.answer: Yes, our processes strictly adhere to the regulatory frameworks of the destination countries, including MHRSD (Musaned) compliance for Saudi Arabia.

item12.question: Is there a minimum order quantity for manpower supply?
item12.answer: We cater to both small specialized requirements and large-scale bulk recruitment for mega projects. Contact us with your specific needs for a tailored solution.

item13.question: How do you ensure candidate welfare and ethical recruitment?
item13.answer: We are strictly against exploitative practices. We ensure transparent contracts, zero hidden fees for candidates where applicable, and comprehensive pre-departure briefings.

item14.question: How can I apply for a job through Future Focus?
item14.answer: You can browse current vacancies on our 'Careers' page and apply directly by submitting your CV and passport copy through our secure online form.

item15.question: Do I need to pay any upfront registration fees?
item15.answer: No, Future Focus Company does not charge unauthorized upfront registration fees. We strongly advise candidates not to pay middlemen or unauthorized agents.

item16.question: How will I know if my application is selected?
item16.answer: If your profile matches a client's requirement, our recruitment team will contact you directly via phone or email for an initial screening and interview schedule.

item17.question: What documents are required for an overseas job application?
item17.answer: Generally, you need an updated CV, a valid passport (with at least 1-year validity), educational/training certificates, experience letters, and recent passport-sized photographs.

item18.question: Do you provide any training before departure?
item18.answer: Yes, all selected candidates undergo a mandatory pre-departure orientation briefing. This covers the host country's culture, labor laws, company policies, and basic safety rules.

item19.question: Is the employer responsible for my accommodation and medical?
item19.answer: In most GCC countries, standard employment contracts mandate that the employer provides free accommodation, transportation, and medical insurance, though this depends on the specific job offer.

item20.question: Can I visit your office directly to drop off my CV?
item20.answer: Yes, you are welcome to visit our physical offices in Dhaka or Riyadh during standard working hours. Please check the 'Contact Us' page for our exact locations and timings.
